question: Inside the already-causal block11 head3 component, does a closure-valid rank-1 axis reproduce the native H3 interchange while its activation-space complement is causally inert?

frozen_design.unit: attn:11:head:03 at each row's semantic prediction position
frozen_design.controls: all P and C rows, 32 each
frozen_design.search_space: empirical span of fit-row native donor-minus-base H3 deltas
frozen_design.objective: mean squared exact-H3 causal recovery error plus lambda=1 mean squared complement recovery
frozen_design.checkpoint_rule: retain the best objective seen, including unoptimized difference-in-means

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_identity_closure: authorities are unchanged and q=I max per-logit error is <=1e-4 on fit, heldout, and A2
predictions.pred_b_exact_h3_is_material: exact H3 recovery is >=0.03 A1-heldout and >=0.02 A2 with direction fraction >=0.75
predictions.pred_c_optimizer_dominates_dim_on_fit_ob: selected best joint fit objective is no greater than DIM plus 1e-8
predictions.pred_d_cdas_axis_and_complement_transfer: learned axis fraction of exact H3 is in [0.50,1.20] on heldout and A2 with direction fraction >=0.75; complement absolute fraction <=0.30
predictions.pred_e_selective_controls: learned-axis normalized P effect <=0.20 and C effect <=0.35
predictions.pred_f_restart_stability: minimum pairwise absolute cosine among the three optimized restart directions is >=0.80

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, q=I closure, native forward, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.objective_mismatch: A/B/C pass but D or E fails
terminal_rules.nonidentifiable: A-E pass but restart stability fails
terminal_rules.null: valid exact H3 ceiling is material but no transferable selective rank-1 axis is identified

interpretation_limits: This is a within-component splitting test, not a cross-layer joint subspace.
The empirical delta span prevents search in dormant directions never changed by the intervention population.
Passing identifies an operational causal axis relative to H3's fixed native coordinate system; it does not yet compile the complete multi-stage circuit.
